title: Organize files across your desktop
description: Grant Cowork access to your cluttered desktop and walk away. It reads your files, figures out what they are, and sorts them into folders while you do something else.
prompt: Please help organize my desktop. Evaluate all of the scattered files and organize based on the contents inside of them.
steps: Describe the task: Grant Claude desktop access; it evaluates scattered files and sorts them into clean folder structures
Give Claude context: Download Claude Desktop, start a Cowork session, grant desktop/folder access
What Claude creates: Scans desktop, categorizes files, creates folder structure with progress updates
Follow up prompts: Reorganize by custom logic, find lost files, create ongoing systems
prerequisites: Optional folder structure preferences and keep/archive/delete rules
notes: Slug differs from page title (page titled 'Organize files across your desktop').
